newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Dalai Lama meet won't hit China ties-Canberra.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Dalai Lama meet won't hit China ties-Canberra.

text.p: Australian deputy prime minister Tim Fischer, defending Prime Minister John Howard's decision to meet exiled Tibetan spiritual leader the Dalai Lama, said on Wednesday he was confident the talks would not upset relations with China.

"I believe that the size, the very volume of the business relationship, the political relationship is so large today that no one circumstance should be allowed to derail (relations)," Fischer told Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.
Beijing threatened trade retaliation after Howard agreed to meet the Dalai Lama on Thursday.
